# O(patience)

> An interactive sorting-algorithm playground. Visualize, race, and quiz yourself on Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and Quick Sort.

## Pages

- Home / Visualizer: https://sortpatience.com/
- Quiz: https://sortpatience.com/quiz
- Embed widget: https://sortpatience.com/embed

## Algorithms covered

Bubble Sort · Selection Sort · Insertion Sort · Merge Sort · Quick Sort
